title: Boss: Raspberry Pi 3
intro: A Raspberry Pi 3 has taken over the exit. It fights in a fixed rhythm: [b]two quiet turns, then two strikes[/b], again and again. [b]attack()[/b] hits the boss in front of you for 2 damage, and [b]block()[/b] raises your shield for one turn. A strike interrupts an attack, and only a block stops the hit. You have 20 HP here, and your armor softens every hit.
cs_note: A [b]loop[/b] is the natural shape of anything rhythmic. Once you know one cycle of the pattern, a repeat plays it as often as you need, and one wrong beat in the body goes wrong in every pass.
hints: Step through with [b]Step[/b] and watch which turns the boss strikes on.
One cycle is four turns: two attacks while it's quiet, two blocks while it strikes. 16 HP at 2 damage a hit is 8 landed attacks.

The boss strikes on turns 3 and 4 of every cycle. Put attack, attack, block, block inside [b]repeat 4 times[/b]: four cycles land exactly 8 attacks and block every strike, so you never get hit. A better weapon from the Shop lets you land fewer attacks.
